descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S27 「日期边界：昨天的计费不当成今天的显示，在今天 Generate 时被替换（3.6 / 3.7），时钟错的浏览器计的系列一样（3.8），两个模式」 Day boundaries: yesterday's billing is not shown as today's and is replaced at today's Generate (3.6 / 3.7), and a browser with a wrong clock bills the same family (3.8), both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • G1 Billing follows its note's retention window: Hospital note 18 h, then kept as the previous note until 36 h; Nursing Home the last two visits. …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；UAT OAT-04 (B)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • G2 Server time, not device time: a browser or phone with a wrong date or another time zone gets the same badge, the same pre-selected template and, after Generate, the same billing family as a device wi …（UAT 3.8；TFA-92584 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21 step 6；TFA-92599 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given yesterday-h / yesterday-n: each fixture seeded with a note, noteGeneratedAt, a billingSuggestion and billingForNoteAt at server now - 19 h (back-dated at seed time, which is seeding, not aging). …

When yesterday-*: open Post-Round before any Generate; then type today's text, Generate and open Post-Round again. clock-*: in the wrong-clock browser open the chart, read the badge and the pre-selected template, Generate with the pre-selected template; repeat with SOAP progress / SNF follow-up picked by hand

Then Before today's Generate there is no billing card for yesterday's note, or one clearly labelled as the previous note's (Q16), and never yesterday's code presented as today's; after Generate the card is today's: it quotes today's note and billingForNoteAt equals today's noteGeneratedAt. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：yesterday legs: before Generate mustNotContain yesterday's code as a current card (99231 / 99308) unless the card is labelled as the previous note's (Q16: recorded, then judged once answered); after Generate mustContainAny the family, mustNotContain the no-result texts, billingCard quotesInNote against today's note and mustNotInclude yesterday-only words ('azithromycin' / 'con …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
